name: "Stunning" Steve Blanchard
caption: The HWO World and Television champion and, with Virus, the defending HWO World Tag Team Champion in a July 2001 tables match.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id pDW3HauP5H4J, 22 July 2001), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/anyone-wanna-critique-a-match-2001-07-22.html. Betrayed by his former partner Sinjin Savage, he tries to hold the belts alone and is put through a table when a turncoat referee calls for the bell. The HWO is the held wing named by the roleplay.

name: Virus
caption: The HWO tag champion, bloody from a chair shot in the July 2001 three-way tables match, who defeated Sinjin Savage in Hell in the Cell the week before.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id pDW3HauP5H4J, 22 July 2001), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/anyone-wanna-critique-a-match-2001-07-22.html. Blanchard's uneasy partner, eliminated by a five-star frog splash through a table after Chris Angel pulls Alex Anderson free. The HWO is the held wing named by the roleplay.

name: Chris Angel
caption: The owner of the HWO, who won ownership in a ladder match, and one half of Corruption X in the July 2001 tag tables match.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id pDW3HauP5H4J, 22 July 2001), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/anyone-wanna-critique-a-match-2001-07-22.html. name: Dutch Blackheart
caption: The mHWO invader who holds the HWO Suicidal Belt and, with Alex Anderson, wins the HWO World Tag Team Championship in July 2001.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id pDW3HauP5H4J, 22 July 2001), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/anyone-wanna-critique-a-match-2001-07-22.html. 6'5" and nearly 285 pounds, he dives over the top rope onto Angel and 8 Ball, is maced, and ends the match as one of the new champions, calling himself the Harvester of Souls. The HWO is the held wing named by the roleplay.

name: Thurman Skydive
caption: The returning special guest referee of the HWO tag tables match of July 2001, who is revealed to be an mHWO member.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id pDW3HauP5H4J, 22 July 2001), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/anyone-wanna-critique-a-match-2001-07-22.html. notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id pDW3HauP5H4J, 22 July 2001), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/anyone-wanna-critique-a-match-2001-07-22.html.
